caption: The video captures a nighttime outdoor scene dominated by a bright, glowing streetlight in the upper-right of the frame. Several thin utility wires stretch across the middle, while a leaning pole stands left and a dim house with windows and low foliage sits lower-left. Heavy rain falls continuously, rendered as numerous bright, slightly tilted streaks lit against the dark sky by the lamp. The positions, lengths and brightness of these streaks shift from moment to moment, marking an ongoing downpour. The streetlight, wires, pole and house remain largely fixed, so the dominant visible motion is the falling rain rather than obvious camera movement. The halo around the lamp and the overall exposure stay roughly constant.
